propositions: test_full_backend_account_is_present deterministically fails on hosts with scc or lizard installed because it asserts metric backend presence without controlling optional metric-tool availability
when the 50-LOC fixture is below the 800-LOC threshold, the installed metric tool returns no findings and emits no metric evidence record, causing test assertion failure
the sibling test test_metric_backend_skip_is_reconstructable already uses explicit _METRIC_CANDIDATES fixture control to ensure host-independent coverage accounting
the fix applies the same missing-metric-tool fixture control to test_full_backend_account_is_present to force deterministic skipped/no_tool coverage records
production grounding behavior and evidence schema must remain unchanged; a successful tool run with no threshold match must not fabricate or abstain from a match record
